claims.text: The hotel sits on a tranquil square surrounded by historic buildings, near Puerta de Sol in the heart of Madrid.

findings.quote: tranquil square surrounded by historic buildings, The Madrid EDITION is near Puerta de Sol in the heart of the Spanish capital

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle of Art, three of Madrid's most important art museums.

findings.quote: within walking distance to The Golden Triangle of Art – three of most important art museums in Madrid

claims.text: From Sol station, the hotel's Celenque Square is about a 300 m walk down Arenal Street.

findings.quote: walk down Arenal Street. Celenque Square will be in the right after 300m.

claims.text: The rooms have modern decor with detailing by Ian Schrager.

findings.quote: stylishly modern decor and posh detailing by Ian Schrager

claims.text: Rooms include floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral and Gran Via.

findings.quote: floor-to-ceiling windows that feature stunning views of the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral and Gran Vía

claims.text: Interconnected rooms are offered for families and groups of up to 8 guests.

findings.quote: For families and groups of up to 8 guests, we offer 77 interconnected rooms.

claims.text: Oroya serves family-style sharing plates such as ceviches, Peruvian-style fried calamari and lucuma desserts.

findings.quote: serves a relaxed menu with family-style sharing plates such as tasteful ceviches, Peruvian-style fried calamari or sweet lucuma desserts

claims.text: Oroya is set in a greenhouse-like room framed by a blackened steel cage with climbing plants and coloured glass panels.

findings.quote: greenhouse-like setting framed by a blackened steel cage clad with climbing plants and coloured glass panels

claims.text: Punch Room is an intimate cocktail bar that revives the ritual of punch, the precursor to the modern cocktail.

findings.quote: Punch Room Madrid is an intimate cocktail bar that revives the ritual of punch—the precursor to the modern cocktail

claims.text: The Spa has a Finnish dry sauna, steam room and relaxation lounge, and is open to day guests as well as hotel guests.

findings.quote: Open to both in-house and day guests, The Spa features a Finnish dry sauna, steam room, relaxation lounge

claims.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre, which guests can use at no charge.

findings.quote: Complimentary use of the 24-hour fitness centre

claims.text: Oroya is the hotel's Peruvian restaurant, led by chef Diego Muñoz, on the 4th floor.

findings.quote: Located on the 4th floor of The Madrid EDITION is the hotel’s sanctuary overlooking the hustle and bustle of the city. Here, you will find Oroya, the restaurant helmed by Peruvian Chef Diego Muñoz

claims.text: The Roof, Oroya's terrace, has a fireplace and a vine-covered pergola.

findings.quote: Oroya’s terrace, The Roof, is an outdoor seductive garden in the sky featuring a fireplace and a vine-covered pergola

claims.text: The rooftop infinity pool on the fourth floor has views of the Teatro Real, the Royal Palace, the dome of the Almudena Cathedral and Casa de Campo.

findings.quote: Located on the rooftop of the fourth floor, in an intimate and exclusive setting, lies the largest infinity pool in the city.
it offers unique views of Madrid, with the Teatro Real, the Royal Palace, the dome of the Almudena Cathedral, and Casa de Campo forming its backdrop

claims.text: The Lobby Bar has a pool table sculpted by designer Emmanuel Levet Stenne from a single slab of white Bianco Neve matt marble.

findings.quote: a shapely pool table, which designer Emmanuel Levet Stenne sculpted from a single slab of white Bianco Neve matt marble

claims.text: Oroya won at the Top Cocktail Bars Awards in 2024, for the third consecutive year.

findings.quote: has led Oroya to win at the Top Cocktail Bars Awards in 2024, for the third consecutive year

claims.text: The pool will be seasonally closed after October 18, 2026.

findings.quote: Please note that the pool will be seasonally closed after October 18, 2026.

claims.text: The Roof terrace is open to hotel residents and the local community alike.

findings.quote: The Roof, the unparalleled rooftop terrace, open to residents and local community alike

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and a modern minimalist style that may not suit traditional preferences.
